# Afternic
> Afternic is a domain marketplace for buying, selling, parking, and monetizing domain names through a global reseller network.

Afternic helps domain investors, businesses, and buyers list domains for sale, distribute listings across partner registrars, negotiate purchases, and optimize domain sales with landers, parking, and transfer services.

## Marketplace
- [Sell Your Domains](https://www.afternic.com/sell-domains): List domains for sale on Afternic and distribute them across its reseller network.
- [Domain Brokerage](https://www.afternic.com/domain-broker): Use Afternic brokers to help acquire domains through negotiation and assisted purchase.
- [Domain Parking](https://www.afternic.com/domain-parking): Park domains with Afternic to monetize traffic while keeping names available for sale.
- [Sales Landers](https://www.afternic.com/sales-landers): Create sales landing pages designed to convert direct domain inquiries into purchases.
- [Lease to Own](https://www.afternic.com/lease-to-own): Offer installment-based purchasing options that make premium domains easier for buyers to acquire.

## Seller Tools
- [Fast Transfer](https://www.afternic.com/fast-transfer): Enable streamlined transfer workflows that help eligible domains sell faster through registrar partners.
- [Sell Your Domains](https://www.afternic.com/sell-domains): Learn how to price, list, and manage domain inventory for marketplace exposure.
- [Sales Landers](https://www.afternic.com/sales-landers): Use optimized landers to capture buyer intent from direct navigation traffic.
- [Domain Parking](https://www.afternic.com/domain-parking): Combine monetization and sales exposure for undeveloped domain names.
- [Lease to Own](https://www.afternic.com/lease-to-own): Expand buyer affordability with recurring payment options for listed domains.

## Buying Domains
- [Domain Brokerage](https://www.afternic.com/domain-broker): Get help sourcing and negotiating domain purchases through Afternic’s brokerage team.
- [Sell Domains | Buy Domains | Park Domains](https://www.afternic.com): Browse Afternic’s marketplace for domains available to buy from sellers worldwide.
- [Lease to Own](https://www.afternic.com/lease-to-own): Purchase eligible domains over time instead of paying the full amount upfront.

## Network and Distribution
- [Fast Transfer](https://www.afternic.com/fast-transfer): Syndicate eligible listings into registrar search paths with integrated transfer fulfillment.
- [Partner with Afternic](https://www.afternic.com/partner): Explore partnership opportunities for registrars and platforms joining Afternic’s distribution network.
- [About Us](https://www.afternic.com/afternic-domain-marketplace): Learn how Afternic operates as a large domain marketplace and exchange reseller.
